description: This file defines the DotListWizardMenu class, which generates HTML markup for a wizard-style navigation menu in a web application, likely part of a CRM module related to campaigns.

classes.name: DotListWizardMenu
classes.description: A class responsible for creating a wizard menu with progression steps, generating HTML fragments for navigation steps, and rendering a progress bar as part of the UI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wizard menu HTML based on provided steps and optional showLinks flag.

methods.name: getWizardMenuItemHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual wizard step items, with conditional links and attributes.

methods.name: getWizardMenuHTML
methods.description: Wraps the individual step HTML in a container including a progress bar by loading an external HTML template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the generated HTML for rendering.
